compiled_state.title: claude-safe worktree cleanup script erroneously deletes active PRs and branches
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Severity: P0

## Problem
While the user was AFK and the autonomous loop was working through bug da45 retroactive review remediation, claude-safe's worktree cleanup script closed 10 active PRs (#200, #202, #203, #204, #205, #206, #207, #208, #209, #210) and deleted their underlying `story/b575-...-scoped` branches from origin at ~2026-05-18T01:01:13Z.

The PRs were in active triage (CI running, LLM review cycle in progress) and were NOT abandoned — they were the scoped retroactive review chain for bug da45-7d92-6c86-42bc (P0). The branches were:
- story/b575-ac1c-f720-4839/aead-ae88-6e97-476b-scoped
- story/b575-ac1c-f720-4839/45da-5043-aa3e-4f3c-scoped
- story/b575-ac1c-f720-4839/b1b6-f770-d682-4a04-scoped
- story/b575-ac1c-f720-4839/62c9-46f5-f287-4c24-scoped (still alive somehow)
- story/b575-ac1c-f720-4839/2d4c-763d-b543-4267-scoped
- story/b575-ac1c-f720-4839/54ff-eb2f-5da6-4721-scoped
- story/b575-ac1c-f720-4839/0652-809a-d1fc-4d36-scoped
- story/b575-ac1c-f720-4839/35b8-abe6-695e-4267-scoped
- story/b575-ac1c-f720-4839/1de0-6a03-24d0-4395-scoped
- story/b575-ac1c-f720-4839/ef20-c04d-d1b4-4b5a-scoped

## Impact
- ~3 hours of cherry-pick + rebase + lint-fix + LLM-finding-triage work lost from origin (still on local reflog)
- Bug da45 P0 remediation set back; user has to re-launch the chain or accept different path
- Trust gap: an autonomous loop cannot run unattended if cleanup script will erase its work mid-flight

## Reproduction
1. Open many PRs from story/** branches via gh pr create
2. Push commits to those branches over the next ~hour
3. Let claude-safe cleanup run on a schedule (cron / VS Code session-end hook)
4. Observe: closed PRs + deleted branches even though work is recent and active

## Suggested fix
Whatever heuristic claude-safe uses to decide a branch is 'stale' must NOT delete:
- Branches with an open PR
- Branches with commits pushed in the last N hours (configurable)
- Branches owned by the orchestrator running an active session

Likely the cleanup is using `git worktree list` + 'has-no-active-worktree' as the staleness signal, but the agent worktrees that created the PR branches are themselves transient — so the agent-created remote branches look stale even though they have an OPEN PR.

## Acceptance
1. claude-safe must respect open-PR signal: `gh pr list --head <branch>` returns ≥1 open → no-delete
2. claude-safe should log every branch deletion with rationale to a recovery log
3. Branches with recent (< 24h) pushes should not be auto-deleted regardless of worktree state
4. Add unit test reproducing this scenario

## Related
- Parent: bug da45-7d92-6c86-42bc (P0; retroactive review chain wiped out)
- Files: plugins/dso/scripts/claude-safe-* (cleanup orchestration)

## Recovery
Branches still live in local git reflog. Can recreate by force-pushing original tips:
```bash
for sha in <reflog SHAs of each branch>; do
  git push origin <sha>:refs/heads/story/b575-.../<sid>-scoped
done
```
But: the LLM-review findings on the deleted PRs are also lost (PR comments only).
